description: This Java class implements the business logic for handling loan account ownership transfers within the Fineract platform, including processing transfer statuses, handling buybacks and sales, and generating related events.

classes.name: LoanAccountOwnerTransferBusinessStep
classes.description: Handles the business logic for processing loan ownership transfers, including sale, buyback, and transfer status management, with event notifications.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to process the loan ownership transfer logic based on current transfer data and statuses.

methods.name: handleSale
methods.description: Processes a sale transfer, including decline handling and event notification.

methods.name: handleBuyback
methods.description: Processes a buyback transfer, including creating new transfer entries and event notification.

methods.name: buybackAsset
methods.description: Handles the buyback asset transfer, updating effective dates, saving to repository, and posting journal entries.

methods.name: sellAssetOrDecline
methods.description: Determines if an asset can be sold or should be declined based on transferability, then proceeds accordingly.

methods.name: sellAsset
methods.description: Executes the sale of an asset, updating previous owner info, status, and posting journal entries.

methods.name: determinePreviousOwnerAndCleanupIfNeeded
methods.description: Determines the previous owner of an asset, handling cleanup if delayed settlement is enabled.

methods.name: determineActiveStatus
methods.description: Determines the active status based on the transfer's current status.

methods.name: getActiveIntermediateOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the active intermediate transfer, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: createAssetOwnerTransferDetails
methods.description: Creates detailed info for an asset owner transfer, including outstanding interest and principal.

methods.name: createActiveMapping
methods.description: Creates a mapping between a loan and its external owner transfer.

methods.name: handleSameDaySaleAndBuyback
methods.description: Handles the scenario where sale and buyback occur on the same day, cancelling both transfers.

methods.name: cancelTransfer
methods.description: Cancels a transfer by creating a new entry with a canceled status.

methods.name: activatePendingEntry
methods.description: Activates a pending transfer by creating a new active entry.

methods.name: declinePendingEntry
methods.description: Declines a pending transfer by creating a new declined entry.

methods.name: createNewEntryAndExpireOldEntry
methods.description: Creates a new transfer entry and expires the old one by setting its effective date.

methods.name: expireTransfer
methods.description: Expires a transfer by setting its effective end date.

methods.name: determineExpectedActiveStatus
methods.description: Determines the expected active status for a buyback transfer.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns the enum style name for this business step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for this business step.
